meta.name: Fauna Minúscula
meta.description: Docuserie que explora los mundos ocultos y las triunfales historias de supervivencia de pequeñas criaturas que viven grandes aventuras a lo largo y ancho de los EE. UU.
meta.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

videos.title: Arizona
videos.overview: In Arizona, critters brave a harsh frontier, and a young kangaroo rat must be nimble to dodge a rattlesnake, a Gila monster — and a dirt bike.

videos.title: New York
videos.overview: While housemates are away, a pampered golden hamster will play. Will he slow his roll when he lands on the streets of NYC and finds true adventure?

videos.title: Minnesota
videos.overview: A burrowing owl evades caddies at a golf course before a ferret forces him far from the fairway. He'll have to outfox his opponents to get home.

videos.title: Texas
videos.overview: In a hostile Texas landscape, a ranch offers fast food to an agile mother mouse. But she must be clever to avoid turning into a barn owl's dinner.

videos.title: Louisiana
videos.overview: Keen eyesight and a playful nature lead the way when a special squirrel explores a suburban home, the least likely place to meet his surprising match.

videos.title: Florida
videos.overview: Intellect meets agility in the Florida Everglades as a high-stakes game of raven vs. rat goes down in a fishing hut. Can these foes ever be friends?

videos.title: Washington
videos.overview: Rescued from the trash and ready to roam, a newly hatched lucky duckling tours her new habitat: a boy's bedroom. But her sanctuary teems with danger.

videos.title: New Hampshire
videos.overview: As night falls, a shy striped skunk prowls for grub till a roving rodent opens up her world. When confronted by a hawk, will she spray or will she go?
